task.design_request: 研究重建：低层高开间中需要保留储物，同时减少主要空间朝窗方向的遮挡；入口与其他用途仍须能够接近。只允许调整高收纳代理的位置与朝向，其他对象固定，记录收益、代价和未知项。输入的尺寸、对象及实例约束均为研究者设定。
unknowns: All dimensions/placements/initial conditions are researcher assumptions; not a survey or historical before-state.
Opaque entry screen is a fixed geometric curtain substitute; no cloth/articulation/material simulation.
Window rays measure geometric visibility only, not daylight, spaciousness or aesthetics.
Same cabinet envelope does not establish usable storage capacity; physical moving and installation unknown.
Whole dwelling functions are represented by static proxies, not validated plumbing/cooking/sleeping/seating.
